column1: # 8장 말투 지시. 열: 조각 앞머리 → 지시(영어, 짧게). @scene 행은 장면 설명. 일기(@letter)는 지시하지 않는다.

column2: Wednesday at Montse's boarding house. Vale, the young Argentine lodger, decides to cook an Argentine asado for Montse tonight and asks Yuna to come shopping with her. Yuna is learning the "ir a + verb" future ("voy a hacer"). Light and friendly.
lightly amused
announcing a plan she is proud of, upbeat
careful, a beginner, using the new "vas a" form
quick and warm, inviting her along

column1: @scene La Rambla es larga y ancha
column2: Vale and Yuna walk down the crowded Rambla to the Boqueria market. Vale warns Yuna about pickpockets with "ojo", pulling down the skin under her eye. At the butcher's, Vale asks for "vacío", the Argentine name of a beef cut; the butcher says in Spain it is called "falda". Busy, cheerful market.

column1: La Rambla es larga y ancha
column2: curious, taking in the crowd
a quick friendly warning, half serious

column1: Hola. Quiero… un kilo y medio
column2: ordering with confidence, then searching for the word "vacío"
puzzled, then helpfully giving the Spanish name; stress "falda"

Walking back up the Rambla, a man bumps into Yuna, apologizes and vanishes; he has cut her bag strap and stolen her bag. Vale runs after him shouting. Yuna's first thought is her grandmother's key, and it is still in her pocket. Shock, then relief.
calm at first, then tense
smiling, too smooth, already moving away
shocked, calling out in a panic
shouting as she runs after the thief
shaky, then relieved
out of breath, angry at the thief, sorry for Yuna
shaken but relieved, reassuring her friend

A police station of the Mossos d'Esquadra. A young female officer starts in English, but Yuna asks her to speak Spanish, slowly, and reports the theft only in Spanish, building each sentence carefully. The officer is kind and patient. Quiet pride grows in Yuna.
tired, a little flat
polite but firm, a beginner who wants to try
surprised and kind; "Vale" means "okay" here; slow and clear
careful, assembling the sentence piece by piece
careful, a beginner, finding each word
careful, a beginner, listing slowly

column1: Es la denuncia. Para el seguro
column2: gentle and sympathetic, slow
sincere thanks with a small joke, a beginner
warm, quietly proud

Sunset outside the police station. Marc, the reserved locksmith, has come on his Vespa to pick Yuna up. He says little, offers her an old phone, and then tells her he will open the old boxes from his grandfather's clock shop in his basement, which his father never opens. Quiet and serious.
tired but calm
low, concerned, a plain question
reassuring, tapping her pocket
plain, practical, low
low, about to say something important
slow, serious, choosing his words
lightly amused, warm
